work_title: Nausicaä of the Valley of the Wind

places.name: Studio Topcraft (Defunct)
places.connection: The animation studio where 'Nausicaä' was produced. After the film's success, its core team was absorbed to form the new Studio Ghibli.

places.name: Tokuma Shoten Publishing Co. Headquarters
places.connection: The publisher of 'Animage' magazine and the primary producer of the film. Their backing was essential for its creation.

places.name: Ghibli Museum
places.connection: Celebrates the art and animation of Studio Ghibli, which was founded following Nausicaä's success. The film is a foundational part of its exhibitions.

places.name: Minamata Bay
places.connection: A real-world location of severe industrial mercury poisoning (Minamata disease) in the mid-20th century. The ecological disaster is cited by scholars as a powerful real-world influence on the film's themes of a poisoned world.

places.name: Syvash (Rotten Sea)
places.connection: A system of shallow lagoons with a distinct, otherworldly appearance. Miyazaki reportedly visited the area, and it is considered by many to be a visual inspiration for the landscapes of the Toxic Jungle.
